services.name: Pontoon Boat Rentals
services.desc: Enjoy a beautiful day on the water! About Pontoon boats are used for pleasure on lakes and rivers, and in some cases on oceans close to shore. Actually, we believe there’s literally a pontoon boat for just about any on-water outing. The next time you’re visiting, make sure to book one of our pontoon boats to experience some of the many watersport activities that could be done with it, such as tubing, waterskiing, and even wakeboarding. You can also add on common pontoon accessories such as an inflatable slide, diving board, and a cover (or “Bimini top”) to shade you from the sun and keep you extra cool while on the waters. Memories Travers City Rentals LLC – Cancellation and Refund Policy Cancellation and Refund Policy: 1.
Full Refund: Cancellations made at least 7 days in advance of the scheduled rental date are eligible for a full refund.
Partial Refund: Cancellations made less than 7 days in advance will incur a 50% surcharge of the total rental cost.
No-Show Policy: Failure to show up at the scheduled rental time will result in a 100% cancellation fee of the total rental cost.
Credit Voucher: In lieu of a refund, a credit voucher will be issued for rescheduling the rental date and time.
Non-Refundable Bookings: Bookings made within 7 days of the rental date are non-refundable.
The credit voucher is non-refundable and cannot be exchanged for cash.
